name: std-algo-astargraph
description: A* engine — each tick expands the min-f (g+straight-line-h) node toward the goal on the weighted biology-canvas.

schema.name: std-algo-astargraph
schema.description: A* engine — each tick expands the min-f (g+straight-line-h) node toward the goal on the weighted biology-canvas.

emits.description: The graph each step — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.
emits.synonyms: tick, frame, step, expand, heuristic, astar, goal, path

events.name: Nodes Updated
events.description: The graph each step — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.
events.synonyms: tick, frame, step, expand, heuristic, astar, goal, path

edges.label: Edges
edges.description: Rendered undirected edges (weight in label); drawing only, A* reads wedges.

goal.label: Goal Node
goal.description: Id of the target node; A* stops once it is expanded.

nodes.label: Nodes
nodes.description: Graph vertices; A* recolours them slate→amber(open)→green(closed), blue=current, red=goal.

start.label: Start Node
start.description: Id of the node A* searches from.

wedges.label: Weighted Edges
wedges.description: Undirected weighted adjacency A* relaxes; each weight exceeds its edge's straight-line length so the heuristic stays admissible.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick expands one node per step; toggle to start/pause the search.

gscore.label: G Scores
gscore.description: Best-known cost from start per node; start 0, others 9999 (infinity sentinel). Not rendered.
